title: The Gauge Said Normal. The Tower Was Nearly Full.
cta: Which link should have broken the chain first? Tell us in the comments

beats.say: Texas City, March {fact24}, {fact1}. A refinery tower {fact7} feet tall is being started up after maintenance.

params.place: the isomerization unit at the Texas City refinery, midday

moments.what: the date and place caption types on over the refinery
the date flashes amber
the camera glides along the pipe racks
the raffinate splitter tower lights up its outline
heat shimmer rises from the furnace
scaffold tags on the unit catch the light

params.caption: date

beats.say: In the control room, its level gauge says the liquid sits near the bottom.

moments.what: the control board flickers on
the level readout lights
the bar sits low, green
the readout glows calm: normal

beats.say: In fact, the liquid is almost at the top.

moments.what: the tower shell turns to glass
the liquid surges up inside
the surface nears the top trays, amber

beats.say: It pours out through relief valves, fills an old vent stack, and erupts into the air like a geyser.

moments.what: liquid rushes down the overhead pipe
the relief valves pop open
the stack fills
a column of liquid bursts from the top
spray falls around the stack

beats.say: It wasn't one failure. It was a gauge that couldn't see, a vent with no flare, and trailers parked too close.

params.place: the unit, the three links pinned on it

moments.what: the camera glides across the unit
a BLIND GAUGE tag pins to the transmitter at the tower base
a VENT, NO FLARE tag pins to the stack
a TRAILERS TOO CLOSE tag pins over the trailers
the three tags glow together

beats.say: Here is the unit, the start-up, the gauge, the overflow, the blast, the findings, and what changed.

moments.what: chapter one lights
chapter two lights
chapter three lights
chapter four lights
chapter five lights red
chapter six lights
chapter seven lights and the title stamps on

beats.say: The BP refinery at Texas City was the third largest in the United States.

moments.what: the camera rises over tank farms and units
the city label types on
the refinery outline traces amber

beats.say: Its isomerization unit turned refinery streams into high octane blending stock for gasoline.

moments.what: the unit label types on
flow lines light along the pipes
the product line pulses
a tanker truck outline at the edge lights

beats.say: Nearby, contract workers were using temporary trailers, set up for maintenance work on another unit.

params.place: the trailer area beside the unit

moments.what: the camera drifts past the racks
work lights glow in the trailer windows
the row of trailers lights its outline
tool carts stand by the doors

beats.say: At its heart stood the raffinate splitter, a distillation tower {fact7} feet tall.

params.place: at the foot of the tower

moments.what: the camera starts to tilt up
the tower name types on
the camera stands at the tower base
the tower name types on
the camera tilts up the full height, a height tag rising with it

beats.say: How does a splitter work? A furnace heats the liquid, the light part boils up the tower, and the heavy part is drawn off at the bottom.

moments.what: the tower drawing appears
the furnace loop lights
blue arrows rise up the tower
an amber line runs out at the base
the outlet tag types on

beats.say: Inside, stacked trays split the liquid into a light part and a heavy part.

moments.what: the shell turns to glass
the trays light one by one
vapour rises, tinted blue
heavy liquid settles at the bottom, amber

beats.say: Normally, only the bottom few feet of the tower held liquid.

params.place: the bottom of the tower, cut away

moments.what: the camera drops to the base
a normal level band lights
the liquid rests in the band

beats.say: How did anyone know the level? A level transmitter watched the liquid. But it could only see the bottom {fact8} feet.

params.place: the level transmitter on the tower base

moments.what: the camera finds the base of the tower
the transmitter box lights
its sensing lines glow
a bracket lights its range
the range tag shows the figure

beats.say: Above that line, the gauge was blind. On March {fact24}, that blind spot would matter.

params.place: the tower, cut away, looking up

moments.what: the range line glows
the camera tilts up past the bracket
the tower above goes dark, unmeasured
the camera stops at the top, dark

beats.say: The unit had been shut down for maintenance. Now crews were starting it up again.

moments.what: scaffold and tags stand on the unit
work lights move along the racks
the furnace pilot glows

beats.say: The night operator began filling the tower with liquid before dawn.

moments.what: the feed line lights
liquid flows into the tower
the level climbs into the normal band

beats.say: He stopped when the gauge read near the top of its range. One high level alarm sounded. The backup alarm never did.

params.place: the tower base and its alarm lamps

moments.what: the liquid settles at the top of the range bracket
the bracket glows full
the high alarm lamp warms
the high alarm lamp flashes amber
the backup alarm lamp stays dark
a red ring circles the dark lamp

beats.say: The start-up procedure said to fill it only to {fact31} on the gauge.

moments.what: the procedure sheet slides over the board
the step line highlights
a target mark lands on the gauge scale

beats.say: Was going past the gauge unusual? No. In {fact29} of the {fact30} start-ups the board studied, the level went beyond its range.

moments.what: a grid of earlier start-ups lays out
each start-up card flips
the cards count up
the cards that went past the range turn amber

beats.say: The operators had been working twelve hour shifts for {fact22} or more days in a row.

params.place: the unit at the shift change

moments.what: the camera finds the control room by the unit
its window band glows
the light inside flickers
a days tag counts up

beats.say: Who was watching? One board operator, running three units from the same console.

moments.what: one chair at the long console
three unit screens light in turn
the screens crowd the desk

beats.say: Mid-morning, the day crew restarted the feed and lit the furnace burners.

moments.what: the sun climbs on the unit
the feed line glows
the burners light, blue then orange

beats.say: Liquid kept flowing in. But the valve that takes liquid out stayed shut.

moments.what: arrows run into the tower
the outlet valve lights
the outlet valve stamps CLOSED

beats.say: For over {fact14} hours, the tower filled and almost nothing left it.

moments.what: a clock face spins on the tower
the liquid climbs past the range bracket
the outlet stays dark

beats.say: Late in the morning, the supervisor left for a family emergency. No one trained took his place.

moments.what: the camera drifts toward the control room
the doorway light goes off
the door stands shut
a caption types: no trained stand-in

beats.say: On the board, the level looked fine. In the tower, it was climbing.

params.place: the control board beside the tower

moments.what: the gauge reads low and steady
its lamp stays green
a second readout appears: the real level, rising

beats.say: What did the operators see, and what was really in the tower?

params.place: inside the tower, beside the board

moments.what: a board readout hangs beside the tower: LOW
the tower turns to glass and a second readout lights: RISING
the liquid inside climbs past the bracket

beats.say: Late morning, the gauge still showed a low level. The real level was {fact9} feet.

moments.what: the board bar sits low
its lamp stays green
the actual readout counts up

beats.say: Before noon, it was {fact10} feet.

moments.what: the real level tag counts up
the liquid climbs higher in the glass tower

beats.say: Early afternoon, {fact11} feet.

moments.what: the level tag counts up
the liquid passes three quarters of the tower

beats.say: Then {fact12} feet, in a tower {fact7} feet tall. And the gauge showed the level falling.

moments.what: the actual readout turns red
the tower outline glows
the tower outline is nearly full
the board bar flickers
the board lamp blinks
the board bar drops, its arrow pointing down

beats.say: Why? The transmitter was set up for the bottom of the tower, and calibrated for a liquid of a different density.

moments.what: the transmitter box lights
the transmitter fills the frame
its range bracket lights low on the tower
its calibration tag flips
the tag shows a different density, struck in red

beats.say: Could they look inside? The only window was a sight glass on the tower. It had been unreadable for years.

params.place: the sight glass on the tower

moments.what: the camera finds the sight glass
a torch beam hits it
dark residue fills the glass
a tag types: nonfunctional for years

beats.say: Minutes later, a safety meeting began in the main control room.

moments.what: the clock ticks on
the meeting lamp lights
the room lamps glow, the board unattended

beats.say: With the tower nearly full, the liquid had one way left to go: over the top.

params.place: the top of the tower, cut away

moments.what: the liquid reaches the top tray
the overhead pipe mouth lights
liquid spills into the pipe

beats.say: What happens when a tower overfills?

params.place: the top of the tower, cut away

moments.what: the liquid surface trembles at the top tray
it spills over the top

beats.say: At the top, liquid spilled into the overhead pipe, which ran back down the side of the tower.

moments.what: the camera is at the tower top
liquid enters the pipe
the pipe outline lights
the camera follows the pipe down

beats.say: At the bottom of that pipe, {fact17} feet down, sat three pressure relief valves.

moments.what: the camera settles at the valves
the camera reaches the valves
the pipe glows above them
three valves light, a depth tag beside them

beats.say: As the pipe filled with liquid, the pressure there rose from about {fact15} to about {fact16} psi.

moments.what: the gauge dial wakes
the needle settles at the top
the pipe colour deepens
the pipe fills on the drawing
a pressure gauge appears at the valves
the needle swings up, the figure climbing

beats.say: The relief valves did their job and opened. For {fact18} minutes, they stayed open.

moments.what: the valve discs lift
liquid jets into the outlet pipe
a timer tag counts
the outlet pipe glows full

beats.say: They sent about {fact4} gallons of flammable liquid to the blowdown drum.

moments.what: liquid runs along the pipe to the drum
the pipe glows amber
the drum fills, a volume tag counting

beats.say: The drum and its stack were decades old, and vented straight to the open air.

moments.what: the drum draws on
the stack draws up
an arrow runs out of the top
the open top is ringed

beats.say: It had never been connected to a flare, which would have burned the vapour off safely.

moments.what: the line flickers
a dashed line to a flare draws on
a ghost flare lights, then goes grey
NOT CONNECTED stamps on the line

beats.say: In {fact28}, a federal inspector had cited a similar drum and stack as unsafe. The citation was later withdrawn.

moments.what: the word unsafe is underlined
a status lamp lights
the file opens
the citation highlights
WITHDRAWN stamps across it

beats.say: The drum overfilled. Liquid erupted from the top of the {fact19} foot stack, like a geyser.

moments.what: spray bursts higher
the drum glows full
a column of liquid bursts from the stack
a height tag rises up the stack
spray rains down around the base

beats.say: The liquid was so volatile that it turned to vapour as it fell.

moments.what: droplets rain past the camera
they shimmer
each drop leaves a haze trail
a low haze spreads over the ground

beats.say: And {fact20} feet from the drum, a pickup truck sat idling, its engine running.

moments.what: a low haze rolls across the ground
the truck comes into view, a distance tag between
exhaust puffs from the truck
the engine note shakes the exhaust

beats.say: Where did it go? A cloud of flammable vapour spread along the ground, toward the trailers.

moments.what: the camera looks down on the unit
the vapour cloud grows on the ground
its edge creeps between the racks
the trailers come into frame

beats.say: At {fact26} past {fact25} in the afternoon, it found an ignition source.

moments.what: the clock ticks to the time
every lamp flashes red

beats.say: What lit it? The most likely source, the board found, was the idling diesel pickup truck.

moments.what: the camera closes on the truck
an AS FOUND tag types on
the exhaust flickers
a spark at the engine

beats.say: Then, in an instant, the whole cloud ignited.

params.place: the unit, the moment of ignition

moments.what: silence; the haze hangs still
the haze shimmers
a flash and a pressure wave roll out across the unit

beats.say: The blast tore through the trailers parked near the unit.

moments.what: the wave reaches the trailers
trailer walls buckle
debris settles, fires burn

beats.say: Some had been placed as close as {fact21} feet from the blowdown drum.

moments.what: the trailers drop onto the plan
a distance line draws from the drum
the distance tag stamps on

beats.say: More than {fact27} trailers were damaged. {fact5} were destroyed.

moments.what: damaged trailers outline amber
a count tag ticks
destroyed trailers fill red

beats.say: A person in a trailer was injured as far as {fact6} feet away.

moments.what: a far trailer lights
a ring draws out from the drum
the ring tag shows the distance

beats.say: {fact2} people died. All of them were in or near those trailers. {fact3} were injured.

moments.what: the trailer area glows softly
the picture dims and the toll types on
the trailer area is outlined softly
the second line types under it

beats.say: Around the refinery, {fact23} people were told to stay indoors.

moments.what: smoke drifts over the fence line
a count tag climbs
house windows light along the street

beats.say: Why were people in trailers so close to a unit starting up? The board asked that too.

moments.what: the unit block outlines on the plan
the trailers glow on the plan
a question mark stamps between trailers and drum
the board seal stamps on

beats.say: The U.S. Chemical Safety Board investigated. Its finding was blunt.

moments.what: the investigation caption types on over the wrecked unit
the camera holds high over the trailer area

beats.say: The disaster was caused by organizational and safety deficiencies at all levels of the company.

moments.what: the sentence highlights
the highlight runs on
a red underline draws

beats.say: Why did it happen? The board traced it link by link.

moments.what: the board lights
a red string runs between cards
the first card pins on

beats.say: Liquid was fed in for over {fact14} hours with none taken out, against the start-up procedure.

moments.what: the finding card types on over the filling tower
the liquid climbs in the glass
the outlet stays dark
CAUSE stamps on the card

finding.text: FED FOR HOURS, NONE TAKEN OUT

beats.say: Instruments and alarms gave false readings, and the operators were likely tired and poorly trained.

moments.what: the transmitter fills the frame
its bracket flickers
the finding card stamps CAUSE
the calibration tag shows a different density
the card holds

beats.say: And there was no requirement to pass on the state of the start-up from one shift to the next.

moments.what: a status lamp lights
card writes on
two shift tags pin either side
it stamps FACTOR

beats.say: Warning signs had been there for years, the board wrote, but company officials did not step in effectively.

moments.what: the page pushes in
a status lamp lights
the page turns to the finding
the line highlights
a red underline draws

beats.say: The blowdown stack was an unsafe design, kept in service despite earlier warnings.

moments.what: the camera rises up the old stack
the open top comes into view
the finding card types on
CAUSE stamps on the card

beats.say: And occupied trailers had been placed too close to a unit handling highly hazardous materials.

moments.what: the camera moves along the trailers
the unit looms behind them
the finding card types on
CAUSE stamps on the card

beats.say: So what changed after Texas City?

moments.what: the camera rises slowly over the cleared trailer area
the empty ground glows softly

beats.say: Did anything change? Months before its final report, the board issued urgent recommendations.

moments.what: the camera moves along the trailers
the unit looms behind them
the light shifts across the siding
a CSB URGENT RECOMMENDATION tag pins over the trailers

beats.say: It asked the American Petroleum Institute to write new guidelines to keep occupied trailers away from hazardous process areas.

moments.what: the addressee line highlights
the request line highlights
a trailer icon slides away from a unit icon
a safe-distance ring draws

beats.say: The institute agreed. And the board called for an alert urging companies to act promptly to place their trailers safely.

moments.what: the camera rises over the trailer area
the trailers start to move
the alert caption types on
the trailers roll away from the unit
the ground near the drum stays empty

beats.say: And the vent stack? The board asked the institute to revise its guide on relief systems, naming the hazards of blowdown drums and urging safer alternatives.

moments.what: an OPEN STACK tag pins to the old stack
the caption types on
the camera drifts toward a new line
a pipe runs out to a flare that rises and lights

beats.say: The last reading before the blast: the gauge said the level was falling. The tower held {fact12} feet of liquid.

params.place: the tower, cut away, the last minute

moments.what: the tower shell turns to glass
a board readout hangs beside it, low
its arrow points down
the liquid inside rises to the top
the actual level tag lands near the top

beats.say: A blind gauge. A tower filled for hours. A stack with no flare. Trailers too close.

params.place: the unit, the four links pinned on it

moments.what: BLIND GAUGE pins to the tower base
FILLED FOR HOURS pins to the tower
NO FLARE pins to the stack
TRAILERS TOO CLOSE pins over the trailers

beats.say: Which link should have broken the chain first? Tell us in the comments.

moments.what: the camera pulls back from the tower
the tower outline lights
it settles on the opening frame
